name: rosetta-environment-variables
code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Environment

Environment.set_environment_variable("ROSETTA_GREETING", "hello")

let name = "ROSETTA_GREETING"

if let greeting = Environment.get_environment_variable(name) then
    write_line("{name} is {greeting}")
fi

let path = Environment.get_environment_variable("PATH")

write_line("PATH is set: {path?}")
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Environment

Environment.set_environment_variable("ROSETTA_GREETING", "hello")

let name = "ROSETTA_GREETING"

if let greeting = Environment.get_environment_variable(name) then
    write_line("{name} is {greeting}")
fi

let path = Environment.get_environment_variable("PATH")

write_line("PATH is set: {path?}")
output:
ROSETTA_GREETING is hello
PATH is set: True
